tips.text: Keep a Death Mark on you and play what you would play anyway; do not grind specifically for him.
Play public squads; every marked squadmate raises his spawn chance and it costs nothing.
Make missions last past four minutes; Defense, Survival and Mobile Defense clear his spawn window.
Run the Hyena Pack on Psamathe, Neptune for marks; each Hyena can grant its own.
Kill The Sergeant on Iliad, Phobos for the fastest single-boss mark; Volt, Gauss or Titania clear it in under a minute.
Stay near squadmates; if he downs you the mark is spent and he leaves, even if you are revived.
Treat a Stalker Beacon as a spawn fix only; it does not improve the blueprint roll.
Use one beacon per mission for the whole squad, and spend any held mark after, since a beacon consumes it.
Fight the Shadow Stalker in Operator form; he cannot adapt to it and your Warframe stays safe.
Never shoot base or Protector Stalker while he is in Absorb; he returns the damage as Magnetic AoE.
Players call Hate the drop people play years without; some get it in their first encounter.
Players regret spending Ducats on beacons for Hate; most of the blueprints that dropped were not Hate.
